profile.headline: eCare Software Engineer at Sentara Healthcare
profile.summary: Epic Sql Report Developer, Epic Beaker certified, Business Objects certification 2008

positions.title: Senior Forms/Report Developer
positions.description:
Currently developing and modifying a series of reports utilizing Crystal Reports version 9.0 and Crystal Reports Server 9.0.
 	Assisting in the conversion project of some reports from Crystal Reports to BIRT (open reporting architecture).
 	Utilizing Oracle 10 as the database backend, integrating Plateau LMS frontend.  Task also includes optimizing current reports utilizing Oracle stored procedures, PL/SQL and advance Crystal Reports objects i.e. command objects, etc.  Extensive use of advanced “regular expressions” for query filtering.
 	Developing complex SQL queries used as BIRT report datasets. Extensive use of SQL Regular Expressions for complex data filtering.
 	Implementing JavaScript and BIRT ROM (Report Object Model) to extend and integrated BIRT report scripting.
 	In-depth understanding to the Plateau LMS data relationships and architecture
